curriculum.title: Capstone Project
points: Participants apply program concepts to design and present a comprehensive project plan addressing a real organizational challenge. The capstone integrates strategy alignment, planning, execution frameworks, stakeholder management, risk mitigation, and customer value considerations. Participants analyze case studies, develop an end-to-end project roadmap, and present their solutions to a review panel, demonstrating leadership, analytical thinking, and practical project decision-making skills.
